messages:
marta: proposal: add a "weighted_failover" hint to region routing decisions so we can prefer cheaper/idle regions but still fall back quickly when latency spikes.

sam: can you sketch the policy? is this per-customer or per-route?

marta: per-route by default, with customer-tier override. basic idea:

```
region_routing:
  policy: latency_primary
  failover_hint:
    type: weighted_failover
    weights:
      us-west: 0.6
      us-east: 0.3
      eu-west: 0.1
    latency_threshold_ms: 120
    max_failover_penalty: 250
```

sam: so if us-west is slightly slower but under threshold, we still send 60% there? :thinking:

anya: +1 on weighted hints. think about sticky sessions for chat/kv-cache so we don't thrash KV caches when we sample.

ryan: important: quotas and reserved capacity for Dedicated customers must override weights. we can't route a reserved-customer into shared-hosted regions.

lee: agree. also need telemetry: per-decision reason codes (e.g. "latency_ok", "quota_block", "variant_unavailable") so console can show why traffic flowed that way.

marta: yes UX: rollout console should surface expected token-cost delta when you change weights, and show a simulated latency distribution.

sam: fallback behavior for model variants? e.g. quantized variant in eu when full-precision in us-west is down we should have variant_fallback_policy too.

anya: propose simple ordered-list per-route: preferred_variant -> cheaper_variant (with min_quality_metric). fallback only if quality drop < X.

ryan: MUST include a circuit-breaker TTL to avoid oscillation. if we failover, keep fallback pinned for N secs unless probe shows recovery.

lee: ops-bot: deployed probe config change to canary cluster (region-prober) sampling 1% traffic for 10m.

ops-bot: region-prober: started sampling for route /v1/generate in us-west/us-east/eu-west at 2025-08-01T15:12Z

marta: next steps: write RFC for the weighted_failover hint + variant_fallback_policy. need eng-platform + runtime to weigh in. tagging @sam @ryan @anya for review.

sam: I'll take runtime implications (KV cache + batch affinity). expect comments by EOD.

anya: I'll write the console mockups for the rollout UX and telemetry views.

ryan: I'll draft the constraints for Dedicated/reserved accounts and quota precedence.

lee: can we add a small example in the SDK for clients to opt-out of cross-region routing? some customers will insist on strict geo.

marta: yes, opt-out flag: `region_routing: { mode: "strict" }` doc that for Private deployments too.

sam: :+1:

anya: :+1:

ryan: :rocket:
